title: What If You Stood on Mercury?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Mercury? You would cook and freeze on the same trip.
Daytime highs reach about 800 degrees Fahrenheit, with almost no air to carry any of that heat.
Night is the opposite. With no real atmosphere to hold heat, it plunges to about minus 290 degrees.
A year there lasts only 88 Earth days, the shortest of any planet.
But sunrise to sunrise takes 176 Earth days, so one day lasts twice as long as its year.
Some craters at the poles never see sunlight at all. Scientists think water ice may be hiding there.
